The '''street hustler''' is a resident of [[Freeside]] who appears briefly {{In|FOTV}}.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Wrangler]]===
This man approaches [[Lucy MacLean]] and [[the Ghoul]] while they walk through Freeside. He is wearing a double-sided sign that reads "BEAT ME UP 4 [[Bottle cap|CAPS]]," written in red paint. As such, he appears to be offering other Freeside drifters the opportunity to inflict physical pain on him, so long as he receives caps as payment. Lucy politely declines his offer and maneuvers around the man.<ref>{{FOTV|2|5}}</ref>

==Appearances==
The street hustler appears only in the ''Fallout'' TV series.
{{FOTV appearances
|13=205
}}

==Behind the scenes==
This character is portrayed by [[Jay Dersahagian]], an uncredited extra. The character is never given a name in the series, nor is he identified as anything other than "a man" in the episode's audio description; the article title is taken from Dersahagian's description of the role on his resume.<ref>[https://archive.ph/Shzs4 Jay Dersahagian's resume (archived)]</ref>

==Background==
It is unknown when or how Subject 476 came to Vault 4, but she was among its numerous test subjects.<ref name="FalloutTV" />

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Trap]]===
Subject 476 is the woman on the holotape recording on [[Vault 4]]'s level 12, giving birth to a spawn of baby [[gulper (TV series)|gulpers]]. Immediately after birth, the baby gulpers turn around and start consuming Subject 476 in a piranha-like manner.<ref name="FalloutTV" />

The '''sunburned man''' is a [[Fallout TV series characters|character]] {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
He is the son of [[Old Woman Gretch]]. In [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2296|2296]], [[Hank MacLean]] took the sunburned man with him during his journey to [[Vault 24]]. Old Woman Gretch was apathetic about the separation, saddened only because her son owed her money, and now she will not get it.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Innovator]]===
[[Lucy MacLean]] and [[the Ghoul]] first hear about the man and his having been taken by Hank MacLean when they find his mother, Old Woman Gretch, at her [[flea soup]] stall.

Lucy and the Ghoul later find the man inside Vault 24, controlled by a [[Brain-computer interface chip|brain chip]] that was inserted into his neck. Hank left him as a "messenger" with a message for Lucy: "I... will... fix this. Come home... Sugar bomb. Come home! Come home! Go!". After saying this, the man's head explodes, showering Lucy and the Ghoul in blood and brain tissue. Lucy remarks that Hank will not stop hurting people.

==Appearances==
The sunburned man appears only {{in|FOTV}}.

{{Infobox character |games =FOTV |image =FOTV Vault 31 Cryobay.png |race =[[Human]] |gender =Female |family = |location =[[Vault 31]] |role =Junior executive |affiliation =[[Vault 31]]/[[Vault-Tec Corporation]] |TV actor = |dod = |dod verified= }} '''Tatyana Lee''' is a pre-War junior executive of the [[Vault-Tec Corporation]] who is currently preserved in [[Vault 31]]. ==Background== Lee was a Vault-Tec junior employee selected to participate in [[Bud Askins]]' executive assistant training program "[[Bud's Buds]]," a plan to create "super managers" who would define the future of humanity after the [[Great War]] wiped out all competitors to Vault-Tec. Lee and the other Buds would be kept in [[Cryonics|cryostasis]] in Vault 31, periodically thawed out and transferred to [[Vault 32]] or [[Vault 33|33]] to manage the dwellers and participate in controlled breeding (eugenics), all under Askins' supervision.[[Norm MacLean]]: ''"So what's Vault 32 and 33? Just people to be controlled?"''
[[Bud Askins]]: ''"What? No! When you put it like that, it sounds downright morally questionable. They're our breeding pool, the ultimate expression of HR R&D. Genetically selected to breed with my Buds to create a class of super managers. People with positivity, people who make lemonade. People who will inherit the Earth after we've wiped the surface clean."''
("[[The Beginning]]")[[Norm MacLean]]
